integrity: Analytical proof and reproducibility code; no claim of independent validation or formal external certification.
scientific_limitations: No mean-square or almost-sure convergence assertion; no nonquadratic extension; fixed alpha outside the motivating sufficient alpha=O(1/tau) region for large tau; earlier exact-gradient LED algorithm explicitly credited; publication priority remains subject to literature risk.
scientific_scope: Exact first-moment dynamics of finite-sum one-dimensional component quadratics for a primal-dual, SAGA-style variance-reduced algorithm with a fixed local stepsize and beta=1/tau. The structural eigenvalue is for the zero-sum dual subspace. The finite-budget construction uses two distinct component curvatures per agent.
title: An exact inverse-budget slow mode for variance-reduced local primal–dual quadratics
